title: Expressive Words
description: Check if a word can be made expressive by expanding groups of identical characters to length 3 or more.
pseudocode:
1. i = 0, j = 0
2. while i < S.length and j < word.length:
3. if S[i] == word[j]:
4. countS = getCount(S, i), countW = getCount(word, j)
5. if countS < countW or (countS != countW and countS < 3): return false
6. i += countS, j += countW
7. else: return false
8. return i == S.length and j == word.length

steps.note: Initialize pointers for S ('heeellooo') and word ('hello')
Match 'h'. Group sizes: S=1, word=1. Valid.
Advance pointers. S group 'e' has size 3, word 'e' has size 1.
Compare 'e' group: S=3, word=1. 3 >= 1 and 3 >= 3 is true.
Move past 'eee' in S and 'e' in word.
Match 'l'. S group size 2 (oops, error in trace, S='heeellooo' has 2 'l's). Re-eval: S group 'l' is 2, word 'll' is 2. Valid.
Match 'o'. S group size 3, word group size 1. Valid.
Pointers reached end of both strings. Return true.
